column1: # derivation: §5.6: float division by zero is IEEE 754: 1.5 / 0.0 = +inf,
# -1.5 / 0.0 = -inf, 2.0 / -0.0 = -inf (the signs of x and the zero),
# 0.0 / 0.0 and 0.0 / -0.0 = NaN; no NULL and no error. 1.0 / 4.0 = 0.25.
# §5.0: a NULL p (id 4, NULL / 0.0) or q (id 8) gives NULL, before §5.6 is
# consulted. NaN is written bare: its sign and payload are the machine's,
# and the harness matches a bare expected NaN against any NaN
# Types: FLOAT64 with FLOAT64 is FLOAT64 under each option of §8.9;
